# Hea015 — Shape healing regression: shared EDGE_CURVE between two ADVANCED_FACEs on same PLANE has duplicate PCURVE_S1_AND_S2 entries (identical UV start and direction)

## Description

A specific shape-healing internal change (gluing edges with pcurves) introduced regression on a class of input shapes — shapes with edges that have pcurves attached to faces sharing an underlying surface. Post-heal results are valid topology but with wrong pcurve parameterisation. Typical input fixture: two ADVANCED_FACEs on the same PLANE share one EDGE_CURVE whose SURFACE_CURVE has two PCURVE entries with `master_representation = .PCURVE_S1_AND_S2.` but both pcurves are duplicates (identical UV start point, identical direction) instead of representing the two opposite sides.

## Reproducer recipe

Two ADVANCED_FACEs on the same `PLANE` sharing one EDGE_CURVE that has a SURFACE_CURVE with two duplicate PCURVE entries (.PCURVE_S1_AND_S2.). After glue-edges-with-pcurves, the edge has only one pcurve and references the wrong face's parameter frame.

## Expected kernel behavior

glue operations preserve all pcurves attached to glued edges; pcurve-to-face binding is preserved.
